checks.name: frozen corpus and judgment identity
checks.limit: Freeze hashes prove captured identity. Authorship/order is recorded provenance; it is not cryptographically authenticated. Later source-document edits may differ from the deliberately frozen snapshot.

checks.name: independent primary relevance metric recalculation
checks.method: Original frozen acceptable labels and raw complete ranked IDs; separate reviewer aggregation without production scorer, oracle, calculateMetrics, or judgeRanking imports.

checks.name: independent comparator subset and metrics
checks.limit: Recalculates membership equivalence and relevance metrics from raw IDs; foreign/runtime source correctness remains separately declared and independently inspected. Models and mandatory output work differ.

checks.name: live pinned foreign source identity
checks.method: Read-only current Git identity, installed version, actual two entrypoint hashes and independently recomputed complete tracked-file aggregate; no foreign execution or write.

checks.name: literal failure eligibility scan
checks.method: Separate simple original-source token/full-record scan for twelve visible failure queries; no production tokenizer/scorer or test oracle import. This checks eligibility and the literal vocabulary mismatch, not relevance-label completeness or score arithmetic.

checks.name: hand arithmetic fixture constants
checks.limit: Independent rational reconstruction validates authored constants; it is separate from live native runtime correctness.

checks.name: captured public correctness replay and hand arithmetic
checks.method: Captured producer replay outcome and loop accounting inspected; four printed scores independently recalculated. This is not a new independent replay of every producer comparison; reviewer literal runtime probes are separate.

checks.name: comparison preserves unsupported tokenless conjunction
checks.finding: Initial review reproduced dropped lexical child through object spread of null; current guard rejects unsupported complete conjunction.

checks.name: independent installed-public literal and rational runtime probes
checks.method: New reviewer literal records and expected IDs, rational hand arithmetic, public package imports only; no benchmark helpers or test oracle.

checks.name: independent Node cost sample and work review

provenance.graphs: Current scoped repeat; directly verified complete graph object identity.

checks.method: Independent ASCII workload identities and algebraic totals/counts, raw grouping/whole-ms median/max recalculation, typed refusal and prior-state checks. Composite source artifacts and every accepted raw row/diagnostic/graph provenance compared directly. Every installed graph module hash is re-read; namespace generation and recorded bundler/gzip method are statically reviewed. Emitted generator counters are observed instrumentation inspected separately, not independently reproduced work-v1 arithmetic or memory bytes.

checks.name: published Node cost tables match accepted raw evidence
checks.method: Printed whole-ms medians/tails, omissions/refusals, emitted counters and all twelve selected graph byte pairs compared directly with accepted raw evidence. Labels checked against selected import scope; no benchmark formatter imported.

checks.name: independent browser cost sample and graph review

uncertainOutcomes.limit: An uncertain restore boundary result. Subsequent complete prior result/revision was observed; this does not retrospectively make the original load a confirmed rejection or successful restore.

checks.method: Raw captured public browser calls recalculated without rerunning browser producer; independent stored application bundle byte/hash/gzip and all graph input identities identify actual staged execution kernels. The current outer browser wrapper identity is separately captured as a candidate file, without a claim of contemporaneous launch capture. Browser work counters and physical memory are explicitly unmeasured.

checks.name: published browser tables match completed raw evidence
checks.method: Every printed browser timing/refusal/uncertainty cell directly compared with completed captured samples and independently recalculated summaries.

checks.name: runtime/public contract and installed package coherence
checks.method: Current/baseline/installed package public maps and zero runtime dependencies compared directly; installed graph/startup capture and unchanged target miss inspected, without inferring memory or physical startup guarantees.

checks.name: independent complete fresh/current/measured runtime identity
checks.method: Separate reviewer directory inventory, byte equality and SHA-256 across every current/measured/fresh production JS/declaration/CSS/notice file, fresh metadata/README/LICENSE and tarball identity; no package-audit helper imported. Audited producer identity script was also rerun separately. No new timing or cross-host claim.

checks.name: captured complete project gate
checks.method: Captured final npm run check log independently inspected and all five suite accounting blocks checked. Parent execution exited0; reviewer did not rerun the complete gate or classify source inspection as runtime tests.

checks.name: initial staged versus current measurement kernels
checks.initialSource: Preserved exact staged-kernel source bytes in durable initial raw artifact. Their identities were also directly checked against the contemporaneous staged files during review.
checks.delta: Four scoped selection-control declarations, two selected loops and selectedModes/selectedSizes report metadata only.
checks.limit: Confirms saved staged-byte identities and current kernel equivalence. An initial wrapper reconstructed after launch remains reconstruction evidence, not a contemporaneous launch-time file hash. The final composite must disclose which observations came from the initial versus scoped repeat runs.
